prompt: Painterly cinematic realism with Old-Master light, one warm grade, fine film grain. Wide shot from high behind a dry ridge: a line of onlookers in silhouette stands along the ridge, backs to the camera, looking down into a wide dry valley. Far below, seen from above at an angle, the half-built ark lies on the dusty valley floor far from any water, a row of bare upright ribs along its top. Dusk, low warm light raking across the valley floor, long shadows. Absurd and uneasy. The ark is one long, low, box-shaped wooden hull with straight sides of rough planks and flat square ends, the same low height from end to end. The ark has no mast, sail, prow, figurehead, funnel or smokestack, no smoke rising from it and no band along its waterline. The ancient Near East before the flood: only goat-hair tents, open fires and torches on the open plain. No stone buildings, towers, churches, glass lanterns, modern clothing or roads. No text, no logos.
